messages:
nina_marketing: Heads-up: running a small pricing UX experiment next Tuesday. Goals: reduce micro-decisions, increase demo claims, and route high-intent calculator results into AE workflow.

omar_growth: sounds good. do we have concrete success metrics?

nina_marketing: primary: demo-claim rate from /pricing from 2.0% -> 3.2% within 30 days. secondary: SQL rate (sales-accepted leads) and reduction in repeat support questions about billing.

lee_prod: idea: use compact tier labels + contextual badges. Proposal: "Sandbox (free)", "Team (shared capacity)", "Enterprise+ (SLA & private)". Each with a single-line blurb under the label.

tara_design: i'll design two visual variants: one with inline micro-FAQ toggles and one with a sticky mini-calculator. both mobile-first.

nina_marketing: calculator changes: show per-1k-token baseline and an estimated monthly cost by tier. add two opt-ins: "Request contract pricing" and "Send me benchmark PDF". selecting contract pricing should flag lead as high-priority.

sam_ops: routing plan: when calculator submit = Enterprise+ AND contract_optin=true -> webhook to /hooks/sales with payload keys: lead_source=pricing_calc, tier=EnterprisePlus, monthly_tokens, est_monthly_usd, priority=high. We'll also attach UTM.

vic_sales: please include suggested lead_reason and quick notes: e.g., "SLA + VPC needed" so AE has context. Also set initial lead_score=60.

jules_cs: for support, i'll prepare a 3-line quick answer we can surface in the micro-FAQ and in the follow-up email. Also short explainer about billing cadence for reserved capacity.

omar_growth: A/B test details? full page variant or incremental?

nina_marketing: A/B: control = current pricing page. variant B = compact labels + sticky calc + inline micro-FAQ. 50/50, run 3 weeks or 8k visitors. Primary metric = demo_claim_clicks, secondary = calc_use_rate and demo-to-SQL within 21 days.

lee_prod: micro-FAQ examples (short): 
Q: How long is a reserved commitment?
A: Typical contracts are 1 or 12 months. Cancel at next billing cycle with 30-day notice.

Q: Does the estimate include private deployment fees?
A: No 10 estimates exclude VPC/HSM and cross-region egress. We'll surface a link to enterprise pricing.

nina_marketing: tracking names: pricing_calc_start, pricing_calc_view_result, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_calc_optin_contract, pricing_demo_claim. omar, can you add these to the tracker and a Looker slice for region + utm_campaign?

omar_growth: yes. I'll add funnel events and a conversion dashboard. will add cohort retention of leads who claimed demo within 7-days.

sam_ops: implementation notes: deploy window 2026-07-14 03:00-05:00 UTC. endpoint for webhook will be ready; will include retry logic and a dead-letter queue for failures.

vic_sales: webinar tie-in: can we add a checkbox in calc for "Invite to cost/performance webinar" so we can seed a targeted webinar for those assessing committed capacity?

nina_marketing: good call. add webinar opt-in. we'll create an email series and a short benchmark narrative for registrants focusing on batching and cache benefits.

jules_cs: after launch i'll craft three canned replies: 1) pricing overview, 2) billing cadence, 3) next steps for enterprise evals.

tara_design: i'll drop mocks in Figma by EOD Friday. nina please confirm final copy for the blurb under each tier.

nina_marketing: confirming copy by Friday AM. final action list: tara designs, lee copy for FAQ, sam tracking, sam_ops webhook + retry, vic webinar flow, jules support templates. reconvene day-before-launch for smoke test.

deploy_bot: Reminder: Experiment "compact-pricing + sticky-calc" scheduled for 2026-07-14 03:00 UTC. CI window reserved 02:00-04:00 UTC. :rocket:
